user.title: Zone Transition
user.description: Tracks the zone history of every person and adds a "Person moved between zones" automation trigger.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Zone Transition is already set up.

moved.name: Person moved between zones
moved.description: Triggers when a person arrives in a zone coming from a different zone. Time spent outside any zone is skipped.

from_zone.name: From zone
from_zone.description: Only trigger when coming from this zone. Leave empty for any zone.

to_zone.name: To zone
to_zone.description: Only trigger when arriving in this zone. Leave empty for any zone.
